'''Charizard Transforms''' (Japanese: '''リザードン、化わる 化わる''' ''{{tt|Lizardon|Charizard}}, Change Change'') is the 589th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 41st chapter of the {{MangaArc|X & Y}}.

==Plot==
{{spoilers}}
The [[Vaniville Town]] children, sans {{adv|X}}, are surprised to learn that [[Salamè]] has been holding onto a [[Mega Stone]] all this time. While [[Xerosic]] insists that no records exist of a {{p|Charizard}} undergoing [[Mega Evolution]], {{adv|Blue}} - finally waking up himself - proposes that he and [[Blue's Charizard|his Charizard]] are living proof of that phenomena, revealing his own Key Stone and Mega Stone. The group notices that the two Mega Stones are of different colors, prompting Xerosic to gloat that at least one of them must not be Charizard's corresponding Mega Stone, and sends out four {{p|Crobat}} to attack. Blue orders {{adv|Y}} to lead the others towards [[Pokémon Village]] while he and X hold Xerosic off; using an [[Awakening]] on [[Croaky]], Y orders a {{m|Smokescreen}} to mask their escape. Under the cover of the smokescreen, Salamé finally [[Evolution|evolves]] into Charizard, much to Xerosic's dismay. Just then, he receives a call from [[Aliana]], who declares that she and the other Team Flare Scientists will intercept Y's group. The four scientists swoop down on Y's group and separate them.

As Salamé struggles to fend off Xerosic's Malamar, Blue points out to X that his Pokémon is waiting for him to use Mega Evolution. The remark strengthens X's resolve, and the two Mega Evolution wielders Mega Evolve their Charizard into Mega Charizard X and Y. Barely dodging an attack from Aliana, Y yells out for her friends, with {{adv|Shauna}} facing [[Celosia]] and {{adv|Tierno}} fighting off [[Mable]], resolving to fight for themselves. {{adv|Trevor}} is cornered by [[Bryony]], who remarks that she won't let him, his friends or {{adv|Zygarde}} interfere with [[Team Flare]], causing Trevor to realize that Team Flare means to activate the [[ultimate weapon]] again. With his {{p|Flabébé}} covering for him, Trevor attempts to escape from Bryony's {{p|Bisharp}}.

With Xerosic's team no match for two Mega Evolved Charizard, X and Blue mount their Pokémon and fly towards Pokémon Village, only to realize that Y's group has been split apart. Salamé manages to rescue Trevor as Blue's Charizard blasts Bisharp away, but as Trevor warns X of Team Flare's new plan, Blue's Charizard is hit by a blast that resembles the attack from the ultimate weapon, and is soon attacked by {{p|Yveltal}}. Y manages to send out [[Xerxer]] to intercept, giving the group a breather to exchange information. Y recalls the Pokémon who Shauna and Tierno saw drained of their life force, prompting X to conclude that Team Flare attacked the Pokémon Village to gather more sources of life force to power the ultimate weapon again.

On {{rt|10|Kalos}}, {{tc|Team Flare Grunt}}s secure the captured Pokémon to the ancient Absorbers. Shauna's {{p|Furfrou}} is among them, and it recognizes Delphox as the {{p|Fennekin}} that got separated from X's group, calling out to Delphox but is ignored. In the [[Team Flare Secret HQ]], [[Emma|Essentia]] curls up on the ground, clutching her head as she suffers a migraine.

==Major events==
* {{adv|Blue}} wakes up and reveals that he is a [[Mega Evolution]] Successor with a [[Key Stone]].
* [[Salamè]] evolves into a {{p|Charizard}}.
* {{adv|Y}}, {{adv|Trevor}}, {{adv|Tierno}}, and {{adv|Shauna}} go on ahead to the [[Pokémon Village]] while {{adv|X}} and Blue fight [[Xerosic]].
* With their Key Stones, Blue and X Mega Evolve {{TP|Blue|Charizard}} and Salamè into Mega Charizard Y and X, respectively.
* The remaining [[Team Flare]] Scientists pick one member of Y's group to fight alone.
** [[Aliana]] chooses to battle Y, [[Mable]] chooses Tierno, [[Celosia]] chooses Shauna, and [[Bryony]] chooses Trevor.
* X and Blue defeat Xerosic and leave to go help their friends.
* [[Malva]]'s {{p|Yveltal}} appears and attacks Blue, but it is blocked by Y and [[Xerxer]].
* Xerxer decides to stay behind and fight Yveltal while Blue, X, Y, and Trevor go on ahead. 
* Y and Trevor decide to stay behind and help Tierno and Shauna while Blue and X head to the village.
* On {{Rt|10|Kalos}}, {{tc|Team Flare Grunt}}s tie captured Pokémon to the ancient Absorbers, and one of the Pokémon turns out to be Shauna's {{p|Furfrou}}, who recognizes {{TP|Malva|Delphox}} and calls out to it.

{{Adventuresevents}}
{{endspoilers}}
